description: Every transfer of a tokenized stock that touched an agent address over a window: the agent and its roles, the token, in or out, the amount and its value, the time and the transaction, newest first (up to 5,000). PAID per call, $0.10 over x402 (USDC on Base) or with a plan; the counts are free in stock_agent_activity.

chain.description: One network: base, arbitrum, bnb, robinhood, ethereum, monad and solana. solana counts balance changes between two surveys, not transfers. Any other is 400 unsupported_network; a network where we list tokens but do not index agent activity (Ink, TON and X Layer among them) says so in networkStatus.

limit.description: How many transfers to return, newest first (default 1000).

q.description: A ticker, company name or ISIN; omit for every stock.

name: stock_agent_transfers

hasMore.description: More transfers in the window than this page holds.

matchingTotal.description: The window’s count, only where this page holds all of it; null otherwise, never the page size.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

says.description: In one sentence: "Showing N latest observed transfers … in the last H hours".

total.description: Deprecated, kept: the rows on this page (returnedCount), not the transfers in the window.

transfers.description: chain, symbol, token, agent, roles, direction, units, valueUsd, ts, txHash, explorer.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Agent transfers of tokenized stocks (paid)
